> **Status: Current planning checklist; no release candidate exists.**
> Baseline product/evidence source: `7edddbdb8e8512627aed0ed42533ef099d802384`.
> This issue tracks case specifications, harness delivery and verification/evaluation. Proposed families and cases are not registered, run or passing merely because this issue exists.

## Goal and dependency

Verify and evaluate the bounded streaming/concurrent Workspace implementation tracked by **[#287](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/issues/287)**.

Keep all seven existing families in the final coverage report. Add proposed Family8 for independent commands in one Workspace and Family9 for multiple Workspaces sharing one daemon/Store, plus cross-cutting memory/work/ownership proofs.

Related acceptance: #248/#256/#249/#219/#259/#261 under #245; deferred traceability #276; observer/completeness #283/#235. This issue does not automatically close the full56/21-case pilots #232/#233, benchmark migration #230, or other unrelated campaigns.

## First publication and registration checkpoint

The local evaluation draft is:

`/Users/yifanxu/.codex/worktrees/issue286-phase-b/layerfs/core/docs/architecture/proposal/bounded-workspace-implementation-20260930/EVALUATION.md`

The implementation issue's R0 must publish the full packet/scenarios at a pinned commit and link it here. Before runner implementation or sampling, commit the roadmap specification for each new/changed selection: IDs/versions/membership, counts/bytes/seed, schedules, public operations, timer boundaries, source arms, topology/cache, resource/worker policy, numeric and correctness limits, independent oracle and exact cleanup/Unknown custody. This body defines the intended coverage; it is not an already frozen numeric contract.

Use the existing harness and report mechanics; do not build a second benchmark framework. No candidate-generated expected result, private product test hook, command classifier or alternate measured mutation path.

## Existing seven-family run/reuse matrix

- [ ] **F1 init_namespace:** public ProjectApi::init, locked release-only binaries,100/1,000/10,000/100,000 rows with actual registration status, independent namespace/selected-content proof and cleanup. If Init/C1/profile/storage mechanisms are unaffected, explicitly reuse proofs. New canonical v2 Init/profile needs its own independent identities/selection. Lite verification is selected-content coverage, not a full payload oracle.
- [ ] **F2 history_retention:** strides10/3/1,17/53/157 states, independent roots/O3/old/new trees/bytes, genuine C2+C5 allocation and accepted up-to10% profile. Reuse unchanged v1 canonical/codec/packing/history evidence. Shared Save/index/engine changes require the smallest affected checkpoint and any further genuinely affected rows; no automatic full-group rerun or codec campaign. SDK/daemon time=N/A.
- [ ] **F3 workspace_write:** nine append/dispersed/repeated cells at100/512/4,097 through SDK Exec/FUSE/Commit. Add partial/nested overlaps, wide overwrite/shrink, no-op restore and affected byte-size variants. Count accepted writes separately from surviving intervals and transmitted replacement bytes.
- [ ] **F4 workspace_commit:** capture/pins/current-G2 install, exact successive predecessor roots, writes during lowering/descriptor/transfer/construction/install, candidate crossing capture, slow consumer, READY protection, known/Unknown/partial terminal and included cleanup.
- [ ] **F5 workspace_namespace:** wide/deep/move/replace/alias/orphan/refusal/refund, deep270 work counts, >128 simultaneous resource-admitted handles, >1,024 listing on one handle, next u16 count boundary, >4,096 wide rebind, parent certification/path locality and exact old/new namespaces.
- [ ] **F6 workspace_mutations:** mixed ordinary operations/refusals, exit7 accepted state, FUSE interrupted read/write/rename publication, daemon-death recovery, truthful df/statvfs and separately authorized explicit discard. Cancel/nonzero exit/unmount does not imply rollback; Unknown forbids guessed discard.
- [ ] **F7 workspace_shell_package:** ordinary install/update/remove,128/129/257/1,025 files/names, retained G1/G2, refresh while another command edits, repeated Commit lineage, maximal encoded results and C5 inode refill with two C2 Save slots occupied.

Families3–7 should be expected to need affected final-source evidence after the rewrite; decide from actual changed mechanisms. Keep every family/case visible as new proof, explicit matched reuse or nonpassing/unrun. A broad source seal alone is not grounds to rerun everything or to claim everything unchanged.

Historical numeric INELIGIBLE and dirty-discard FAIL receipts remain unchanged. The10,240 selection stays owner-deferred; >65,535 final-run and other boundary obligations may use focused external correctness/count proofs rather than an automatic long performance sweep.

## Proposed Family8 — independent commands in one Workspace

A shell forking children does not prove concurrent independent SDK Exec admission. Freeze exact command counts/sizes/schedules before implementation.

- [ ] **F8-A distinct files:** two SDK writers/readers accept real work before either completes; exact bytes/output/head and no long lifecycle/global exclusion.
- [ ] **F8-B same-file overlaps:** two positional writers target partial/nested overlaps. Prove last-accepted-publication semantics, intact retained regions and atomic accepted syscalls; conflicting inode serialization with unrelated-file progress.
- [ ] **F8-C Exec + Commit:** G1/G2 capture boundaries, writes through each Commit phase, immediate saved predecessor, old/pinned/live bytes and next Commit.
- [ ] **F8-D second Commit:** precise same-W Busy while first submission is pending, no second publication/replay, live writes remain correct.
- [ ] **F8-E cancel/disconnect:** exact command-domain/channel cleanup, accepted writes survive, sibling command/channel continues.
- [ ] **F8-F descendants/output:** leader exit, setsid/double-fork and pipe-holder variants, domain/reaping/pipe/terminal distinction, bounded8KiB/stream capture and bounded unsent liveness.
- [ ] **F8-G counts:** declared active levels2/4 when admitted, plus many sequential completed commands; actual-resource admission, no hidden command cap or retained-history scan/state.
- [ ] **F8-H external launch:** authorized externally supervised mounted-path create/write/truncate/rename/unlink uses the same filesystem mutation semantics, then public Commit; separate route label and explicit external process custody.

Dedicated lifetime correctness: a healthy quiet command actually exceeds30s while another short/control operation progresses, then exact terminal/cancel cleanup. Freeze a finite functional harness bound. It is not a15/25s performance selection and does not enlarge existing callback/Commit/benchmark limits.

Use deterministic real process/kernel/provider coordination and independent expected bytes. Start order is not publication order. Two PIDs/submitted RPCs or a sleep do not prove overlap. Held-I/O/fault schedules are labeled correctness diagnostics, separate from ordinary performance rows.

## Proposed Family9 — multiple Workspaces in one daemon/Store

- [ ] **F9-A count policy:** configured1/2/3 variants, exact simultaneous live count, next-create refusal without partial visibility, replacement after exact cleanup, retained/closing count, separate sandbox isolation and no lower singleton/two ceiling.
- [ ] **F9-B independent execution:** two/three mounts, ordinary file/namespace progress, isolated data/output/handles and cross-actor denial.
- [ ] **F9-C independent Commits:** separate Branches, independent submissions, exact roots/parents and progress under unchanged C2/worker capacity.
- [ ] **F9-D shared Branch:** explicit expected-head conflict, at most one matching CAS successor, losing save/stage/cleanup custody and no automatic merge/rebase/resend.
- [ ] **F9-E bulk versus small/control:** W-A bulk Commit and W-B small/control work; protected progress between bounded quanta, no unrelated whole-Commit global-lock wait. Genuine exhausted bulk capacity can refuse.
- [ ] **F9-F close/failure isolation:** close/cancel/exhaust A while B runs; no cross-W kill/refund/channel loss, stale incarnation cannot affect replacement, retained owners keep slots/quota.
- [ ] **F9-G catalog refill:** two occupied C2 Save slots and a third W exhausting its real admitted serial range; authenticated C5 refill progresses before full Save completion, without smaller ranges/raised quotas.
- [ ] **F9-H resource/pin pressure:** active Commits/commands plus selected views, per-W child/private quota and protected completion; composed accounting, exact retained bytes and precise admission/refusal.

Shared Store/allocator integrity failures may legitimately quarantine their declared broader domain; do not promise universal per-W isolation for corruption. Use precise per-W quota/child failures for narrower isolation claims.

## Cross-cutting proof matrix

- [ ] **Writes versus surviving delta:** repeated same range, partial/nested overlap and separated ranges; record accepted counts/bytes, final intervals/descriptors/replacement and actual cleanup. No historical-WRITE replay.
- [ ] **Successive generations:** bounded new edits over increasingly fragmented predecessors; first-touch opaque parent span, no historical extent re-enumeration and exact immediate-parent roots.
- [ ] **Files/directory width:** independently vary dirty identities, wide directories and graph depth; admitted resident windows, monotone cursors, exact external ordering and honest ancestor/release work.
- [ ] **Payload bytes:** sparse inherited versus dense/fresh input; actual byte passes, boundary reads, replay/temp high-water and physical file cache. Ordinary prepend/copy pays its real moved bytes.
- [ ] **Active concurrency:** vary idle Workspaces and admitted active operations; idle W does not reserve full Commit scratch. Memory can grow with active windows/pins inside the global budget; additional work may refuse.
- [ ] **Pins/cleanup/failure:** last-owner release, physical allocated/reserved/refunded credit, exact location contexts, known and Unknown retained outcomes. SQLite freelist/high-water is distinct from logical row deletion.
- [ ] **Lifetime state:** many sequential commands with fixed active concurrency; no growing command/PID/timer/output population or repeated historical scan.
- [ ] **Physical memory:** separated SDK/Server/SQLite/daemon/child anon/file/shmem/kernel/socket/dirty/writeback domains, real simultaneous allocation/clone overlap and healthy progress. Lifetime memory.peak is not a phase peak; verify same-owned-FD reset/read where supported. Heap-only and cgroup OOM containment alone do not pass.

These also require independent v1/v2 root/partition ledgers, semantic parent certification/cycle/alias refusal, schema11 quiesced locator migration and new v2 Stack import, >32KiB result/framing/EOF/terminal tests,16/31/32KiB and65,535/65,536/128KiB pinned reads, long-name listing, partial authenticated I/O and no mutation replay.

## Performance selection, topology and evidence rules

Start with four compact ordinary performance mechanisms: **F8-A**, **F8-C**, **F9-C** and **F9-E**. All other witnesses still require correctness/resource proof; add a speed row only when it answers a prospectively declared mechanism question.

- Existing family-specific frozen limits remain. New ordinary complete performance commands default to<=15s, with a small declared<=25s exception list; separate new verification stays<10s. No workload shrink, raised timeout/worker/quota or hidden cleanup to make a row pass.
- One sample per case/arm; no n3/best-of/unchanged-arm replay. Diagnose from retained receipts or labeled count-driven cause probes. Preparation clone/build/image reuse is recorded and never credits timed work.
- Preserve declared host SDK/coordinator/Server/SQLite and Linux daemon/FUSE/workload topology. No Docker-owned SQLite/prepared Store or silent backend/hosting change.
- Native-Linux Server physical-containment capability is a separate product resource proof; it cannot replace or be pooled with current benchmark arms. Unsupported physical/cache/observer capability remains INCOMPLETE/INELIGIBLE/UNAVAILABLE.
- No candidate-derived oracle; verify complete declared old/new/pinned state, exact bytes/metadata/names/absences/alias identity, heads and cleanup outside the speed timer.
- Preserve one construction producer per operation, actual Store capacity and up-to10% history allocation tolerance. Never trade approximately5% storage for approximately50% speed loss; no speculative compression/page-size/worker campaign.

## Required report and completion

- [ ] One coverage table for all existing7 families and every newly registered member, with exact new/reused proof identity and all FAIL/INCOMPLETE/INELIGIBLE/NOT_RUN/deferred cells.
- [ ] Complete-command makespan plus per-command admission/start/terminal/Exec and per-W capture/head/live-G2/Commit/cleanup. Actual overlap events and small/control responsiveness; do not add overlapping spans.
- [ ] Accepted operations/bytes, final changed bytes, transfer bytes, page/graph/owner work, writer waits and capture/install holds; complete Server/transport/daemon/FUSE attribution or explicit unavailable reason.
- [ ] Per-domain memory, temporary/final physical allocation, protected credits/pins/retained owners and exact cleanup disposition.
- [ ] Independent correctness, custody, resource, cleanup and numeric cache eligibility verdicts. No2x claim from two callers or functional PASS promoted to numeric PASS.
- [ ] Follow benchmark_agent_report.md; append-only raw/compact receipts, exact reproduction commands/source/tree/product/compilation/harness/image/fixture/oracle/cache identities and measured interference.
- [ ] Meaningful external contract/harness tests and final owning locked Core tests/examples/fmt/Clippy, boundary/self-tests, exact platform gaps and per-commit production LOC (test/harness/docs-only commits still report unchanged production totals). No CI or retired aggregate preflight.
- [ ] Publish the exact admitted profile and remaining unsupported/deferred capabilities; close related issues only when their own full acceptance is satisfied.

Delivery order: publish/freeze contracts and independent oracles; prove the coherent single-W Commit path and actual resource boundaries; select affected existing-family evidence; qualify lifetime/FUSE/channel/domain semantics; prove Family8/9 overlap/isolation/admission/failure; complete final-source run/reuse coverage and the four focused performance selections. Full56/21-case pilot campaigns and later larger tiers remain separate selections.
title: Phase 5: benchmark streaming Commit and concurrent Workspace workloads
